race.comment: ZONKSTAR (3) jumped quickly from 1450m to 2000m and was lining up for only the third time when the easy winner of a Canberra BM65 last start. Enjoys a little weight relief and is open to plenty of further improvement so this is not out of reach. HALLOWED HALLS (2) was ridden closer to the speed but didn't quite have the turn of foot required over 1800m at Rosehill most recently. Rock-hard fit after three runs back from a spell and the extra ground is just what he needs now. Lightly raced mare BLENHEIM GIRL (8) wound up powerfully to be beaten just half a length over 1800m at Rosehill last start. Carries only 52.5kgs after the claim and looks well placed out to this trip. LUGARNO (4) returned to form at Rosehill seven days ago. Getting back on a good track will enhance his prospects. WAR RIBBON (7) cannot be left out of calculations despite coming back from a 12-week lay-off.
